title: CapabilityHistory
description: Append-only transition log for capabilities. See OBSERVATORY_V1_SPEC.md §4.7. Each record carries a stable transition_id, a capability_id, a monotonically increasing sequence per capability, a from state (null only for the genesis record), a to state, an as_of_commit, an evidence_id (when the transition is supported by a specific evidence record), a recorded_at timestamp, and a short editorial reason. Ordering is (capability_id, sequence). recorded_at is metadata, not ordering authority.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump on any change to the transition shape.

transitions.description: The append-only log of capability transitions.

capability_id.description: The capability this transition applies to. Resolves to a record in capabilities.json.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing per capability_id, starting at 1 for the genesis record. recorded_at is metadata, not ordering authority.

from.description: The previous state. Null only for the genesis record (sequence: 1).

to.description: The new state. Must be a valid maturity state.

as_of_commit.description: The git commit SHA at which the transition was observed.

evidence_id.description: Optional evidence record supporting the transition. Resolves to a record in evidence-index.json when present.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Metadata, not ordering authority. Sequence is the ordering authority.

reason.description: Short editorial reason for the transition. Not freeform prose; a one-sentence explanation of why the transition occurred.

allOf.description: The genesis record (sequence: 1) must have from: null.
Non-genesis records (sequence > 1) must have a non-null from state.
